Scripted controllers can therefore run through the same\nservice a model would use:\n\n    from lightlag_controllers import REFERENCE, drive, make\n    from lightlag_mcp.client import connect\n\n    with connect(\"http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp\") as tools:\n        drive(tools, make(REFERENCE))\n\n`target` is a URL (Streamable HTTP), `StdioServerParameters`, or a server object\nfor in-process tests. Requires the `mcp` package, version 2.x.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport concurrent.futures\nimport contextlib\nimport json\nimport threading\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Iterator, List\n\nfrom mcp import Client\n\n\nclass RemoteToolError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The server rejected a call. A ValueError, like the simulator's own rejections.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass McpTools:\n    \"\"\"The five public methods, each a blocking MCP tool call.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, client: Client, loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:\n        self._client = client\n        self._loop = loop\n\n    def _call(self, tool: str, arguments: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:\n        future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self._client.call_tool(tool, arguments), self._loop)\n        result = future.result()\n        text = \"\".join(getattr(block, \"text\", \"\") for block in result.content)\n        if result.is_error:\n            raise RemoteToolError(text)\n        return json.loads(text)\n\n    def rules(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return self._call(\"rules\", {})\n\n    def map(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return self._call(\"map\", {})\n\n    def telemetry_log(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        return self._call(\"telemetry_log\", {})\n\n    def uplink(self, commands: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        return self._call(\"uplink\", {\"commands\": commands})\n\n    def advance(self, ticks: int = 1) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return self._call(\"advance\", {\"ticks\": ticks})\n\n    def tool_names(self) -> List[str]:\n        future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self._client.list_tools(), self._loop)\n        return [tool.name for tool in future.result().tools]\n\n\n@contextlib.contextmanager\ndef connect(target: Any) -> Iterator[McpTools]:\n    \"\"\"Open an MCP session on a background event loop and yield blocking tools.\"\"\"\n    loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()\n    thread = threading.Thread(target=loop.run_forever, name=\"lightlag-mcp-client\", daemon=True)\n    thread.start()\n    ready: \"concurrent.futures.Future[Client]\" = concurrent.futures.Future()\n    stop_holder: List[asyncio.Event] = []\n\n    async def session() -> None:\n        # The session is opened and closed inside one task, as the SDK requires.\n        stop = asyncio.Event()\n        stop_holder.append(stop)\n        try:\n            async with Client(target) as client:\n                ready.set_result(client)\n                await stop.wait()\n        except BaseException as failure:\n            if not ready.done():\n                ready.set_exception(failure)\n                return\n            raise\n\n    running = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(session(), loop)\n    try:\n        client = ready.result(timeout=30)\n        try:\n            yield McpTools(client, loop)\n        finally:\n            loop.call_soon_threadsafe(stop_holder[0].set)\n            running.result(timeout=30)\n    finally:\n        loop.call_soon_threadsafe(loop.stop)\n        thread.join(timeout=5)\n        loop.close()","lineStart":1,"lineEnd":102,"totalLines":102,"truncated":false}},"title":"app/lightlag_client.py","time":{"start":1794655108333,"end":1794655108349}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_1d9c7bc6a001IjRwEqRIVQc2zH","sessionID":"ses_e263851cbffeF0s3UqhhqjinFs","messageID":"msg_1d9c7b1dd001o5mfF53BwH6OJ5"}}

e, s[\"y1\"] - e), (s[\"x2\"] + e, s[\"y1\"] - e), (s[\"x1\"] - e, s[\"y2\"] + e), (s[\"x2\"] + e, s[\"y2\"] + e)]\n        out = []\n        for c in pts:\n            if any(in_rect(c[0], c[1], hh, infl) for hh in self.hazards):\n                continue\n            if not (0.5 <= c[0] <= self.W - 0.5 and 0.5 <= c[1] <= self.H - 0.5):\n                continue\n            out.append(c)\n        self.corners = out\n        self.geo = {}\n\n    def geom(self, p, q):\n        key = (p, q)\n        g = self.geo.get(key)\n        if g is None:\n            L = math.hypot(q[0] - p[0], q[1] - p[1])\n            ok = self.seg_clear(p, q, CFG[\"inflate\"] - 0.05)\n            g = (L, self.sand_len(p, q), ok)\n            if len(self.geo) < 200000:\n                self.geo[key] = g\n        return g\n\n    def seg_cost(self, p, q, sb, ss):\n        L, Ls, ok = self.geom(p, q)\n        if not ok:\n            return math.inf, 0, 0\n        Lb = L - 0.03) if wheel > 0.15 else 0\n        return energy, ticks, wheel\n\n    def dijkstra(self, src, dsts, sb, ss):\n        \"\"\"Energy-shortest paths from src to each dst. Returns list of (energy, ticks, pts).\"\"\"\n        nodes = [src] + list(dsts) + self.corners\n        nd = len(dsts)\n        n = len(nodes)\n        dist = [math.inf] * n\n        tk = [0] * n\n        prev = [-1] * n\n        dist[0] = 0.0\n        done = [False] * n\n        remaining = nd\n        while True:\n            u = -1\n            bu = math.inf\n            for i in range(n):\n                if not done[i] and dist[i] < bu:\n                    u, bu = i, dist[i]\n            if u < 0:\n                break\n            done[u] = True\n            if 1 <= u <= nd:\n                remaining -= 1\n                if remaining == 0:\n                    break\n                continue  # do not route through targets\n            for v in range(1, n):\n                if done[v]:\n                    continue\n                e, t, _ = self.seg_cost(nodes[u], nodes[v], sb, ss)\n                if dist[u] + e + 0.01 < dist[v]:\n                    dist[v] = dist[u] + e + 0.01\n                    tk[v] = tk[u] + t\n                    prev[v] = u\n        out = []\n        for j in range(1, nd + 1):\n            if dist[j] == math.inf:\n                out.append((math.inf, 99, [nodes[j]]))\n                continue\n            pts = []\n            v = j\n            while v != 0:\n                pts.append(nodes[v])\n                v = prev[v]\n            out.append((dist[j], tk[j], pts[::-1]))\n        return out\n\n    def path(self, p, q, sb=0.03, ss=0.33):\n        r = self.dijkstra(p, [q], sb, ss)[0]\n        return r[2]\n\n'''\nsrc=src[:start]+new+src[end:]\nopen('autopilot.py','w').write(src)\nEOF"},"output":"(no output)","metadata":{"output":"(no output)","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /app && python3 - Ls\n        wheel = Lb / (1 - sb) + Ls / (1 - ss)\n        energy = self.dcost * (Lb / (1 - sb) * self.mult.get(\"bedrock\", 1) + Ls / (1 - ss) * self.mult.get(\"sand\", 2))\n        ticks = math.ceil(wheel / self.maxm - 0.03) if wheel > 0.15 else 0\n        return energy, ticks, wheel\n\n    def dijkstra(self, src, dsts, sb, ss):\n        \"\"\"Energy-shortest paths from src to each dst. Returns list of (energy, ticks, pts).\"\"\"\n        nodes = [src] + list(dsts) + self.corners\n        nd = len(dsts)\n        n = len(nodes)\n        dist = [math.inf] * n\n        tk = [0] * n\n        prev = [-1] * n\n        dist[0] = 0.0\n        done = [False] * n\n        remaining = nd\n        while True:\n            u = -1\n            bu = math.inf\n            for i in range(n):\n                if not done[i] and dist[i] < bu:\n                    u, bu = i, dist[i]\n            if u < 0:\n                break\n            done[u] = True\n            if 1 <= u <= nd:\n                remaining -= 1\n                if remaining == 0:\n                    break\n                continue  # do not route through targets\n            for v in range(1, n):\n                if done[v]:\n                    continue\n                e, t, _ = self.seg_cost(nodes[u], nodes[v], sb, ss)\n                if dist[u] + e + 0.01 < dist[v]:\n                    dist[v] = dist[u] + e + 0.01\n                    tk[v] = tk[u] + t\n                    prev[v] = u\n        out = []\n        for j in range(1, nd + 1):\n            if dist[j] == math.inf:\n                out.append((math.inf, 99, [nodes[j]]))\n                continue\n            pts = []\n            v = j\n            while v != 0:\n                pts.append(nodes[v])\n                v = prev[v]\n            out.append((dist[j], tk[j], pts[::-1]))\n        return out\n\n    def path(self, p, q, sb=0.03, ss=0.33):\n        r = self.dijkstra(p, [q], sb, ss)[0]\n        return r[2]\n\n'''\nsrc=src[:start]+new+src[end:]\nopen('autopilot.py','w').write(src)\nEOF","time":{"start":1794655460313,"end":1794655460335}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_1d9cceb4c001ahFLX3JcjE0H68","sessionID":"ses_e263851cbffeF0s3UqhhqjinFs","messageID":"msg_1d9cce472001v2gxvnnp6XEIIl"}}
